title: Reading Drill — Choosing library study chairs — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing library study chairs — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Hillswick began with reports of chairs being moved into aisles during busy sessions. The library facilities team had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using floor measurements and chose the width of clear paths as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was chairs with smaller footprints. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted eight weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded changes in occupancy as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
